title: OpenRouter AI token usage Sep 28 to Oct 25?
description:
This market will resolve according to the total number of tokens processed on OpenRouter for the four weeks of September 28 to October 25, 2026.

The total number of tokens is the sum of the weekly totals displayed in the Top Models chart on OpenRouter's AI Model Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings#top-models) for the weeks of September 28, October 5, October 12 and October 19, 2026. OpenRouter's weeks run from 12:00 AM UTC on Monday to 11:59 PM UTC on Sunday, and a week's figures continue to update until the following week's figures are first displayed.

This market will resolve according to the totals displayed for those four weeks once the figures for the week of October 26, 2026 are first displayed. If the figures for the week of October 26, 2026 have not been displayed by 11:59 PM ET on October 30, 2026, this market will resolve according to the totals displayed for those four weeks at that time.

This market will resolve based on the totals as displayed on the chart, including any rounding applied by OpenRouter. If the total falls exactly on the boundary between two brackets, this market will resolve to the higher bracket.

The resolution source for this market is https://openrouter.ai/rankings.
